cohort: A total of 50 patients at high risk for post-partum haemorrhage (e.g., multiparity, twin pregnancy, polyhydramnios, multifetal pregnancy, preeclampsia) were included.
finding: A single IV dose of Carbetocin 100 microg administered after delivery is sufficient to maintain adequate uterine contraction, preventing uterine atony and excessive bleeding with efficacy comparable to hours of oxytocin infusion.
